Name: Pet Follow
Author: TormadMcleod
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Pet Follow lets your pets follow you around.
Right click the pet once to make it follow you and right click it again to tell it to stay. You can also call a pet by typing its name in chat.
The mod should work with basic modded custom pets.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Install SMAPI.
Download and unzip Pet Follow.
Place the PetFollow folder into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
Launch the game through SMAPI.
Configure Config to your preferences, by defualt pets only follow you in your farm but you can select allowed areas in the config 
For multiplayer, every player should install the same version of the mod.[/color]

[code] [center][img=10%]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48970/48970-1783900108-1489734244.png[/img][/center] [/code]
[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
Pets can follow the player who last interacted with them.
Right click again to make the pet stay.
Call pets by typing their name in chat.
Pets can follow across enabled locations.
Pets return home at night.
Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support.
Works with vanilla pets and standard Stardew 1.6 custom pets.

[code][center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/48970/48970-1783700775-859903909.gif[/img][/center][/code]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
SMAPI is required.
Generic Mod Config Menu is optional, but recommended for changing settings in game.
For multiplayer, all players should install the mod.
